description: Points de localisation des gares de la ligne 15 sud du Grand Paris Express is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Société du Grand Paris. Le Grand Paris Express est un projet de métro automatique qui s’inscrit dans le cadre du Nouveau Grand Paris des transports et dont la réalisation va s’échelonner d’ici à 2030. Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Transport, Métro, Transports en commun, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 16 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2015-03-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
